subject: Coffee & Tea
title: The Coffee Nap
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Coffee Nap usable.

hook.text: Drink coffee and immediately nap for 20 minutes. You'll wake up more alert than either alone would provide.

buildup.text: Sleep naturally clears adenosine from receptors. Caffeine takes 20 minutes to absorb into the brain.

discovery.text: By napping during the absorption window, you clear adenosine while caffeine moves in to block the empty receptors.

twist.text: Studies show coffee naps improve performance on driving and cognitive tests more than coffee or naps separately.

climax.text: The key is keeping the nap under 20 minutes—longer and you enter deep sleep, causing grogginess instead.

punchline.text: Coffee plus a 20-minute nap. Science's best alertness trick.

quiz.question: Why does a coffee nap work?
options: Sleep clears adenosine while caffeine absorbs to block the empty receptors
The heat from coffee relaxes you
